programmes.d: Before walking the runway in Fascinating Fascinators, the queens bring out their best celebrity impressions for Snatch Game, and Ts Madison sits in with the judges.
The queens are paired up by psychic Char Margolis and challenged to make over their partners as their own drag doppelgangers, and Loni Love joins the judges.
The queens compete in a RuPaul's Drag Race-themed trivia game, write and star in commercials for their own self-branded sodas, and walk the runway in Beast Couture.
The queens roast past Miss Congeniality winners Heidi N Closet, Nina West and Valentina, special guest Norvina stops by, and comedian Loni Love sits in with the judges.
The queens get acting advice from Scarlett Johansson before starring in a sci-fi spoof, then walk the runway in Haute Pockets couture, and Cynthia Erivo joins the judges.
Before heading into the grand finale, the Top Four queens record a verse to the song "Lucky," choreograph a performance with Jamal Sims and sit for an interview with RuPaul and Michelle Visage.
In this virtual reunion, the eliminated queens share music video performances, the Top Four answer revealing questions, RuPaul gets the backstage tea, and two lip-sync assassins face off.
The Top Four girls compete in a final lip sync smackdown, the queens pick the Season 13 Miss Congeniality winner, and RuPaul crowns America's Next Drag Superstar.

The new A-List series hits the city of bulls, boots, and boys, boys, boys! In this premier episode, meet our wildly successful Texas A-Listers who are determined to wrangle anything their heart desires, even if it means stirring up a little drama.
The drama is bigger in Texas! The southern boys get into even more trouble.
Things get heated down South, as the A-Listers' true colors come out.
Hey y'all! The drama continues in Dallas.
The A-Listers discover that someone isn't being completely honest.
He did what?! One of the A-Listers decides to come forward with the truth.

Fresh off the heels of his blowout fight with Phillip, James licks his wounds and tries to navigate the aftermath with his friends. However, things don't patch up so easily for James: Ashley won't stop texting him, and he is "dead" to Phillip.

Looks like Levi has got his hands full yet again. Combine a needy new boyfriend, an upcoming rodeo competition and Ashley's new charity - it's a wonder he has any free time at all! Will Chase be able to rope Levi into a full-time relationship?

Chase is trying to play it cool but it's obvious he's fallen head over heels for Levi, who still refuses to make their relationship official. Chase decides to take some time apart with the hopes that distance will make Levi's heart grow fonder.

The A-List: Dallas boys and their gal pal Ashley are back and they're ready to face off for another round of Texas style, over-the-top drama. Wendy Williams returns to host this outrageous reunion special.
Jo and Blair discover the joys of friendship in a Facts of Life parody. Russian former KGB agent and chorus girl Svetlana kills for the gig. Lesbian Speed Dating.
All in the "Gay" Family wonders what life would be like in the extremely gay household of Archie and Eddie. The Ladyline women's hotline sketch gives new meaning to the word "hot".
Beware of the airline front desk agent in Checking In and the full moon in the adventures of Gay Werewolf! Logo Life Tips teaches you how to save money by making your own Glitter.

Tyra Banks milks the drama to its fullest throughout this episode as she tries to pick a finalist in America's Next Top Model. The further adventures of the Gay Werewolf turns a wedding upside down during an untimely full moon.
Part 1 of the Season 14 Split Premiere. A new cast of queens, competing for $100,000, must show off their performance skills in a talent show. Superstar singer Lizzo guest judges.
